items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: But the -- I asked Matthew about it later when he was up here, came up here.

ctx.x: That was before he tried to pull my arm out of the socket. I just kept quiet. (inaudible) just keep quiet. And so I didn't say anything to him. Matthew didn't say anything to him, just (inaudible) stand up against the wall. He had to get over there in his position. Well, I don't know why Matthew walked in front of him.

But the -- I asked Matthew about it later when he was up here, came up here. I said, I wonder why Joe would make a statement like that? He said, oh, man, don't pay him no mind. He's got a loose screw. Everybody knows he's got a loose screw (inaudible) or something like that, said, we don't even speak.
